title: Apply Java 21 pattern matching to observer code
description:
The bridge just got Java 16+ instanceof pattern matching applied (removing redundant casts). The observer module (Mage.Client.Observer) likely has similar patterns — instanceof checks followed by explicit casts — that should get the same treatment.

Also look for opportunities to use Java 21 switch pattern matching (type patterns in switch expressions) for any instanceof chains dispatching on data types.
